cat > mime/mime.go <<'EOF'
package mime

import (
	\"io/fs\"
	stdmime \"mime\"
	\"sort\"
	\"strings\"

	\"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/conf\"
	\"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/log\"
	\"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/resources\"
	\"gopkg.in/yaml.v3\"
)

var LosslessFormats []string

func init() {
	conf.AddHook(load)
}

func load() {
	data, err := fs.ReadFile(resources.FS(), \"mime_types.yaml\")
	if err "'!= nil {
		log.Fatal("Error reading MIME types configuration", err)
	}

	var config struct {
		Types    map[string]string `yaml:"types"`
		Lossless []string          `yaml:"lossless"`
	}
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(data, &config); err != nil {
		log.Fatal("Error parsing MIME types configuration", err)
	}
	if config.Types == nil || config.Lossless == nil {
		log.Fatal("MIME types configuration must define types and lossless")
	}

	for ext, typ := range config.Types {
		if err := stdmime.AddExtensionType(ext, typ); err != nil {
			log.Fatal("Invalid MIME type configuration", "extension", ext, "type", typ, err)
		}
	}

	LosslessFormats = make([]string, 0, len(config.Lossless))
	for _, ext := range config.Lossless {
		LosslessFormats = append(LosslessFormats, strings.TrimPrefix(ext, "."))
	}
	sort.Strings(LosslessFormats)

	// Some Windows configurations identify JavaScript as text/plain.
	_ = stdmime.AddExtensionType(".js", "text/javascript")
	_ = stdmime.AddExtensionType(".css", "text/css")
}
EOF
